snippet.title: Light and Shadow - Doppelganger - Official PV
snippet.description:
In this cruel world, Nora's originally happy life is over in a flash. In order to repay the kindness of her adoptive parents, she resolutely embarks on the path of revenge. Will she become a revered paladin or an assassin of darkness?
